This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for
`scripts/analyse_16s_community_ecology.qmd`. It describes the whole community
first: composition, alpha diversity, and beta diversity across the two membrane
systems over three cleaning cycles and two phases.

The experimental boundary is binding. There is one membrane per condition, so
condition is confounded with membrane identity. Every condition term below is a
longitudinal difference between two specific systems, never a replicated
treatment effect. Phase structure is examined before any thought of collapsing
phases, and the results table records that check explicitly.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/analyse_16s_community_ecology.qmd [phyloseq_dir] [output_dir]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: analyse-16s-community-ecology
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
phyloseq_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_PHYLOSEQ_DIR")
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_ECOLOGY_DIR")
if (!nzchar(phyloseq_dir) || !nzchar(output_dir)) {
  abort("Provide phyloseq_dir and output_dir, or source config/16s_analysis_paths.sh first.")
}
for (pkg in c("phyloseq", "vegan")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) abort("Package %s is required.", pkg)
}
set.seed(20260901L)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

physeq <- readRDS(file.path(phyloseq_dir, "16s_phyloseq.rds"))
counts <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(physeq), "matrix")
if (phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(physeq)) counts <- t(counts)
taxonomy <- as.data.frame(as(phyloseq::tax_table(physeq), "matrix"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
design <- as.data.frame(as(phyloseq::sample_data(physeq), "data.frame"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
design <- design[rownames(counts), , drop = FALSE]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- composition
# Family-level profile with the same remainder grammar as the manuscript MAG
# figure: unclassified is kept distinct from classified-but-not-shown.
family <- taxonomy$Family[match(colnames(counts), rownames(taxonomy))]
family[is.na(family) | family == ""] <- "Unclassified at family level"
family_counts <- t(rowsum(t(counts), group = family))
relative <- family_counts / rowSums(family_counts)

unclassified_label <- "Unclassified at family level"
if (!unclassified_label %in% colnames(relative)) {
  relative <- cbind(relative, matrix(0, nrow = nrow(relative), ncol = 1,
                                     dimnames = list(rownames(relative), unclassified_label)))
}
classified <- setdiff(colnames(relative), unclassified_label)
ranked <- names(sort(colMeans(relative[, classified, drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE))
top_n <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_TOP_FAMILIES", "25"))
kept <- head(ranked, top_n)
other <- setdiff(classified, kept)

profile <- data.frame(relative[, kept, drop = FALSE], check.names = FALSE)
profile[["Other classified families"]] <- if (length(other)) rowSums(relative[, other, drop = FALSE]) else 0
profile[[unclassified_label]] <- relative[, unclassified_label]

composition <- data.frame(
  sample_title = rownames(profile),
  design[rownames(profile), c("condition", "phase", "cycle", "cycle_phase")],
  profile, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
long_composition <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(profile), function(fam) {
  data.frame(
    sample_title = rownames(profile),
    design[rownames(profile), c("condition", "phase", "cycle", "cycle_phase")],
    family = fam,
    relative_abundance = round(profile[[fam]], 6),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
write.table(composition, file.path(output_dir, "16s_family_profile_wide.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(long_composition, file.path(output_dir, "16s_family_profile_long.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

phylum <- taxonomy$Phylum[match(colnames(counts), rownames(taxonomy))]
phylum[is.na(phylum) | phylum == ""] <- "Unclassified"
phylum_relative <- t(rowsum(t(counts), group = phylum))
phylum_relative <- phylum_relative / rowSums(phylum_relative)
write.table(
  data.frame(sample_title = rownames(phylum_relative), round(phylum_relative, 6),
             check.names = FALSE),
  file.path(output_dir, "16s_phylum_profile_wide.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------- alpha diversity
# Computed on unrarefied counts. Depth sensitivity is reported next to the
# estimates rather than removed by discarding reads.
depth <- rowSums(counts)
alpha <- data.frame(
  sample_title = rownames(counts),
  design[rownames(counts), c("condition", "phase", "cycle", "cycle_phase")],
  read_depth = depth,
  observed_asvs = vegan::specnumber(counts),
  shannon = round(vegan::diversity(counts, index = "shannon"), 4),
  simpson = round(vegan::diversity(counts, index = "simpson"), 4),
  inverse_simpson = round(vegan::diversity(counts, index = "invsimpson"), 4),
  pielou_evenness = round(vegan::diversity(counts, index = "shannon") /
                            log(vegan::specnumber(counts)), 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
common_depth <- min(depth)
alpha$rarefied_richness_at_min_depth <- round(
  vegan::rarefy(counts, sample = common_depth), 2)
alpha$rarefaction_depth_used <- common_depth
chao <- t(vegan::estimateR(counts))
alpha$chao1 <- round(chao[rownames(counts), "S.chao1"], 2)
alpha$chao1_se <- round(chao[rownames(counts), "se.chao1"], 2)

depth_correlation <- stats::cor.test(alpha$read_depth, alpha$observed_asvs,
                                     method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
write.table(alpha, file.path(output_dir, "16s_alpha_diversity.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

# -------------------------------------------------------------- beta diversity
# Two views: Bray-Curtis on relative abundance, and Aitchison distance on a
# centred log-ratio transform, which respects the compositional nature of the
# data. Conclusions are only reported where both agree.
relative_asv <- counts / rowSums(counts)
pseudocount <- 0.5
clr <- log(counts + pseudocount)
clr <- clr - rowMeans(clr)

distances <- list(
  bray_curtis = vegan::vegdist(relative_asv, method = "bray"),
  aitchison = stats::dist(clr, method = "euclidean")
)

ordination_rows <- list()
permanova_rows <- list()
dispersion_rows <- list()

for (metric in names(distances)) {
  d <- distances[[metric]]

  pcoa <- stats::cmdscale(d, k = 3, eig = TRUE)
  eigenvalues <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]
  variance_explained <- round(100 * eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues), 2)
  ordination_rows[[metric]] <- data.frame(
    sample_title = rownames(pcoa$points),
    design[rownames(pcoa$points), c("condition", "phase", "cycle", "cycle_phase")],
    metric = metric,
    axis1 = round(pcoa$points[, 1], 5),
    axis2 = round(pcoa$points[, 2], 5),
    axis3 = round(pcoa$points[, 3], 5),
    axis1_percent_variance = variance_explained[1],
    axis2_percent_variance = variance_explained[2],
    axis3_percent_variance = variance_explained[3],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Terms are entered cycle first because cleaning cycle is the dominant axis
  # in the metatranscriptome. by = "margin" avoids order-dependent attribution.
  model <- vegan::adonis2(d ~ cycle + phase + condition, data = design,
                          permutations = 9999, by = "margin")
  permanova_rows[[metric]] <- data.frame(
    metric = metric,
    term = rownames(model),
    df = model$Df,
    sum_of_squares = round(model$SumOfSqs, 5),
    r_squared = round(model$R2, 5),
    f_statistic = round(model$F, 4),
    p_value = model$`Pr(>F)`,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (factor_name in c("condition", "phase", "cycle")) {
    groups <- design[[factor_name]]
    if (nlevels(droplevels(factor(groups))) < 2) next
    disper <- vegan::betadisper(d, droplevels(factor(groups)))
    test <- vegan::permutest(disper, permutations = 9999)
    dispersion_rows[[paste(metric, factor_name)]] <- data.frame(
      metric = metric,
      factor = factor_name,
      f_statistic = round(test$tab[1, "F"], 4),
      p_value = test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

ordination <- do.call(rbind, ordination_rows)
permanova <- do.call(rbind, permanova_rows)
dispersion <- do.call(rbind, dispersion_rows)
rownames(ordination) <- NULL
rownames(permanova) <- NULL
rownames(dispersion) <- NULL

# Check sampling-phase structure before pooling initial and backflush samples.
phase_check <- permanova[permanova$term == "phase", c("metric", "r_squared", "p_value")]
phase_check$collapsing_phases_supported <- phase_check$p_value > 0.05
phase_check$note <- "Descriptive only; six observations per membrane, no biological replication."

write.table(ordination, file.path(output_dir, "16s_beta_ordination_coordinates.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(permanova, file.path(output_dir, "16s_beta_permanova.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(dispersion, file.path(output_dir, "16s_beta_dispersion.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(phase_check, file.path(output_dir, "16s_phase_structure_check.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(list(distances = distances, clr = clr, relative = relative_asv,
             family_profile = profile, design = design),
        file.path(output_dir, "16s_ecology_objects.rds"))

interpretation <- data.frame(
  statement = c(
    "condition_is_confounded_with_membrane_identity",
    "observations_are_temporal_not_biologically_replicated",
    "alpha_diversity_depth_spearman_rho",
    "alpha_diversity_depth_p_value",
    "phase_collapsing_supported_bray_curtis",
    "phase_collapsing_supported_aitchison"
  ),
  value = c(
    "TRUE", "TRUE",
    round(unname(depth_correlation$estimate), 4),
    signif(depth_correlation$p.value, 4),
    as.character(phase_check$collapsing_phases_supported[phase_check$metric == "bray_curtis"]),
    as.character(phase_check$collapsing_phases_supported[phase_check$metric == "aitchison"])
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(interpretation, file.path(output_dir, "16s_interpretation_guards.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

print(permanova)
print(phase_check)
cat(sprintf("\nWrote community ecology results to %s\n", output_dir))
cat("Read the condition term as a difference between two membranes, not as a treatment effect.\n")
```
